title: skills(objectstack-ui): the navigation rule teaches the approvals inbox entry gated by `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'` — which hides it from every approver until a request already involves them
body:
Found by a downstream app on the published 18.4.0 packages (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#83, PR #87).

## The trap

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` (line ~39) — and its eval in `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` — teach the approvals entry as:

```ts
{ id: 'nav_approval_requests', type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_approval_request', label: 'Approval Requests', icon: 'inbox', requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request' }
```

An app that copies it (as HotCRM-derived apps do, with `type: 'component', componentRef: 'approvals:inbox'` plus the same `requiresObject`) gets **history-dependent visibility**, measured on 18.4.0: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` answers **404** to a non-administrator approver (sales manager, quality manager, director) until some approval request already involves them, then 200; administrators always 200. The console prunes the entry against the served objects, so on a fresh environment **no approver sees the inbox entry** — while the approval centre itself works for all of them through the approvals REST path.

The platform's own Account app gates the same component differently: `nav_account_approvals` in `@objectstack/platform-objects` uses `requiresService: 'approvals'`, with the comment "`requiresObject` cannot gate a component item"; plugin-approvals also warns against granting non-administrators read on its tables.

## Why it matters

The skill is what AI authors copy; it currently teaches a gate that stages clean, validates, and hides the entry from exactly the users it exists for.

## Suggested fix

Teach the approvals inbox as `type: 'component', componentRef: 'approvals:inbox', requiresService: 'approvals'` (the Account app's shape), state why `requiresObject` is wrong for it, and update the eval.

Dedupe words: approvals inbox nav requiresObject skill example · requiresService approvals · navigation rule approvals.
